work_completed: Workspace for the thumb (owner 25/11, mobile first): Rodar/Parar as a floating button bottom-right on phones (top bar on wide screens), hidden while typing; game controls moved to a bottom bar with a single cycling speed chip; frame time in the stage corner; the bar has four tabs (Código, Jogo, Recursos, Notas), Recursos groups art, maps and sounds and opens the Studios.

A1 Sprite Studio in the shell (SpriteStudioView over Lunet.Studio SpriteDocument/SpriteHistory): full-screen pixel canvas with onion skin and grid, pencil/eraser/fill/picker, undo/redo per stroke, palette, frames (add/duplicate/delete), animation preview; Back saves the .sprite.json and its .png sheet together (StudioAssetWorkspace bundle) with a portable PNG encoder.
A1 common canvas (ZoomCanvas: fit, pinch zoom, two-finger pan, wheel, stroke cancel) shared by both Studios; Sprite Studio colour picker (HSV, alpha, hex).

A2 Tile Studio in the shell (TileStudioView over TileStudioSession/TileMap): visible layers drawn from the tileset, collision tinted, layer chips (new, visibility, collision), tile palette from the tileset, brush/eraser, undo/redo per stroke, Tileset opens the Sprite Studio and returns; new maps get an editable four-tile tileset; Voltar saves the .tilemap.json.

A4 sound effects Studio in the shell (SoundStudioView over SoundDesigner): categories, regenerate, vary, waveform view, main knobs applied on release, play through MediaPlayer on Android; Voltar saves .sfx.json and .wav together.

P2 mind maps in the shell (MindMapView over ProjectMindMap/MindMapHistory) as an outline: fold, edit in place, Enter for the next topic, + child, sibling, outdent, remove; every change written at once in Notes/, undo/redo.

A3 Music Studio in the shell, first slice (MusicStudioView over MusicSong/MusicRenderer): new songs from Starter, piano roll per pattern and track (scale lit, other tracks faint, drag keeps add/remove), starting fitted to the height on phones, tracks and patterns (new, duplicate), tempo, play pattern or song; Voltar saves .song.json and .wav together.

P6 Versões (Git) in the shell (GitView over Lunet.Git): start history with the ignore list, changes with diff, save a version (stage all + commit, signer kept in the repo config), versions list with changed files; remote send/receive still opens the previous Git screen (tokens in the device vault).

A5 particles Studio in the shell (ParticleStudioView over ParticleDraft/ParticlePresets): live preview with the game's ParticleEmitter on a software GraphicsDevice, presets, main knobs, start/end colours, additive glow, tap-to-burst; Voltar saves the .particles.json the game loads.

A5 game palette in the shell (PaletteView over ProjectPalette, Assets/palette.json): presets, extract from the game's sprites, add by hex, ramp and harmonies from a selected colour, remove; saved at once; the Sprite Studio offers the game's palette.

A5 Data Studio in the shell (DataView over DataTable, Content/Data): records as cards on the phone, a record as a form with a typed editor per column (text, numeric keyboard, switch, choice), rejected values show the reason and are not written; new record as a thumb FAB; duplicate/remove records; add/remove columns; table problems on top; .json and .schema.json written together; Back goes record → list → workspace.

A1 selection in the shell's Sprite Studio: Select tool with rectangle, lasso, same colour (wand) and all; drag inside moves (SpriteFloating), apply/undo/rotate/flip/duplicate (stamp)/erase in a contextual row above the tools; one undo step per lift; changing tool/frame or leaving applies the floating pixels. The sprite format has no layers (SpriteDocument), so there is no layer gap in the Sprite Studio.

A2 Tile Studio terrain and layers in the shell: Terrain tool (AutotileSet Sides16/Blob47 from the chosen tile, paint/erase, the reason when the tileset lacks tiles); layer ⋮ row with rename, reorder, show/hide, collision and remove (confirmed, at least one layer).

A3 Music Studio in the shell: bottom tabs Notas/Faixa/Arranjo; note length 1–16 steps (clipped to the pattern); per-track instrument presets with preview, volume, pan, mute, solo, new track; arrangement order chips with earlier/later/remove and append current pattern; tempo in Arranjo; empty order plays the current pattern.

P6 Git remote in the shell's Versões: origin address (https, validated by Lunet.Git), account (GitAccountStore at LunetShell.GitAccountPath = the previous screens' FilesDir/git-account.json; token never in the game folder), Receber (pull + reload from disk) and Enviar (push) with progress and reasons; LunetShell.GitTransport hook; tested end to end against real git (ProcessGitTransport, bare repo, a second clone pushing).
